metadata.title: Warm Tonal Portrait with Filigree Overlay

recipe.visualDefinition: A close-up, high-angle portrait of a woman looking downward, bathed in warm, monochromatic orange and terracotta tones. The composition is layered with a delicate, light-colored line-art filigree pattern and features clean, modern typography positioned in the lower-left quadrant.
coreVisualRelationships: Warm skin tones harmonizing with the terracotta background
Delicate filigree lines contrasting with the soft-focus photographic depth
Minimalist geometric typography anchoring the organic curves of the subject
High-angle perspective creating a sense of intimacy and introspection
coreInvariants: Monochromatic warm color story (oranges, reds, browns)
Soft, diffused lighting with minimal harsh shadows

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is positioned on the right two-thirds of the frame, cropped tightly from the head to the shoulder.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and eyes, looking down, serve as the primary emotional anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the subject's face, follows the downward gaze to the shoulder, and then moves left to the typographic element.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The left side of the frame provides breathing room, filled with the background color and filigree pattern.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Terracotta and burnt orange (background and shadows)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: White and pale pink (typography and filigree)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the mid-tones with low value contrast, creating a glowing, unified effect.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid cool tones like blues or greens
Limit black to very small areas like eyelashes

characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase 'h' used as a large graphic monogram with an elongated vertical stem
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family using weight and scale for hierarchy.
graphicDevices: Vertical divider line in the monogram

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric purity and circular counters.
Provides the necessary clean, modern geometric feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A soft-focus, high-angle portrait of a woman looking down, color-graded in warm terracotta and orange tones. Overlay a subtle, thin-line beige filigree pattern across the entire image.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place a geometric sans-serif name in the lower left. Below it, create a large lowercase 'h' monogram with an elongated stem, using white for the text.

verificationChecks: Is the color palette strictly warm and monochromatic?
Is the filigree pattern subtle enough not to distract from the face?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the orange color grading
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject

mustAchieve: Seamless integration of graphic overlay and photography

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the filigree does not obscure the subject's eyes.
Check that the white text is legible against the background.
Verify the high-angle perspective is maintained.
Confirm the monochromatic orange tone is consistent across the frame.
recipe.reuseFormula: Warm-toned portrait + fine-line vector filigree + geometric sans-serif typography in lower-left quadrant.
